metric.name: startup_ttfd_ms
metric.sql_used:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.startup.startups;
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.startup.time_to_display;
WITH
  cold AS (
    SELECT s.package, d.time_to_full_display AS ns
    FROM android_startups AS s
    JOIN android_startup_time_to_display AS d USING (startup_id)
    WHERE s.startup_type = 'cold'
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT package FROM cold GROUP BY package ORDER BY count(*) DESC, package LIMIT 1
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT ns, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ns) AS rank, count(*) OVER () AS n
    FROM cold
    WHERE package = (SELECT package FROM app) AND ns IS NOT NULL
  )
SELECT (SELECT ns / 1e6 FROM ranked WHERE rank = (n + 1) / 2) AS value

claims.text: The startup metric is based on 20 cold starts in each trace, but the individual current-trace values vary substantially, so one capture per side cannot establish that the delta exceeds run-to-run noise.
The only range commit that touches the localized feed handler merely renames the Handler field and its post call; it does not show a behavioral startup change.

caveats: The captures were taken on an emulator (sdk_gphone64_arm64, SDK 36).
The current build is a non-debuggable benchmark build; baseline build metadata was not recorded.
The measured startup delta is not sufficient to attribute a regression to a commit in the supplied range.

dropped_claims.text: Median cold-start time to full display increased from the baseline trace to the current trace.
